verdict.rationale: Swell has an official CLI for scripted work on apps, themes and storefronts, with commands such as `swell app init`, `swell app push` and store switching. Its backend API can be driven programmatically using basic auth with environment-specific secret keys (sk_test_/sk_live_) and official Node/PHP libraries. It also advertises a validate-deploy-verify loop for agents, so headless automation is plausible, but nothing documents CI use specifically. Missing for 10: documented CI/CD integration or non-interactive CLI authentication (e.g. token via environment variable), any example pipeline, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration.
